inside.title: Inside circloo
inside.body: A calm workspace for your circle: live icebreakers, check-ins and boards, with circloo ready to help.

tour.title: circloo in 20 seconds
tour.lead: A circle forms, circloo runs an icebreaker, the team decides on a live board, and the results go to Teams, Jira or Notion.
tour.description: Silent video. The circloo face smiles; eight friends join a circle as characters; circloo asks a question and two people answer; notes and votes fill a Start, Stop, Continue board; results are sent to Teams, Jira and Notion; Pirikoo the parakeet lands next to the face.

story.title: Watch a circle come to life
story.lead: Six short moments from one circle, from the first hello to the follow-up.

circle.label: Gather
circle.title: One link brings everyone in
circle.body: Share a link or a short code. Each person joins with a first name and a character, no email needed.
circle.video: Silent video. Eight friends join a circle one by one as characters, and the circloo face smiles wider with each arrival.

chat.label: Break the ice
chat.title: circloo runs the activity with you
chat.body: It asks the question, keeps the pace and lets everyone answer in their own words. You get to play too.
chat.video: Silent video. The circloo panda asks what small thing made you smile this week, and two friends answer.

canvas.label: Think out loud
canvas.title: One canvas, everyone at once
canvas.body: Drop notes anywhere, pick their colour and shape, and watch each friend’s cursor glide by with their character.
canvas.video: Silent video. Notes land on a dotted canvas while three friends’ named cursors move around; one note is dragged and starred.

board.label: Decide
board.title: Decide together, live
board.body: Notes go into columns, everyone votes with dots and the favourite rises. Retros, trips and family plans in minutes.
board.video: Silent video. Notes drop into Start, Stop and Continue columns, then dot votes land on them.

send.label: Follow up
send.title: Results go where your team works
send.body: Send the summary to Microsoft Teams, Jira, Confluence or Notion in one click, so nothing gets lost after the meeting.
send.video: Silent video. A summary card flies to Teams, Jira and Notion and comes back with a check each time.

pirikoo.label: Ask
pirikoo.title: Pirikoo answers your questions
pirikoo.body: Not sure where something is? Ask Pirikoo the parakeet in your language and get a short, clear answer.
pirikoo.video: Silent video. Someone asks Pirikoo how to invite people; the parakeet writes, then answers step by step.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.lead: Still curious? Start a circle and see for yourself.

items.a: No. You type your email and we send a six-digit code. People you invite by link only need a first name.

items.q: Who can see what happens in my circle?
items.a: Only its members and the people you invite. Circles are private by default and there are no ads.
Yes, while circloo is in early access. If we ever add a paid plan, we will tell you well before anything is charged.

items.q: Can my company use its own login?
items.a: Yes. Single sign-on with Entra ID, Google Workspace, Okta or any OIDC or SAML provider is set up through configuration, not custom code.
English, French, Arabic (with a full right-to-left layout) and Spanish. Jokes are written natively in each, never translated literally.
